snippet.title: Dosa Divas - Official Gameplay Trailer | Day of the Devs: Summer Game Fest Edition
snippet.description:
Battle a rotten fast food empire in Dosa Divas, a spicy turn-based RPG about reconnecting with culture and cooking (of course). Pilot your colorful spirit-mech through vibrant villages, fight corporate goons, and experience a tale of life, love, and loss.

Dosa Divas will be released on PC and consoles in early 2026. Wishlist it on Steam now.
